Since it's beneficial for FP-17 to be top-ranked, I'd fund all four and rank them as follows: 1) FP-17, 2) P-04, 3) P-12, and 4) P-09. This ranking meets the committee's and reviewers' expectations. I could summarize the decisions in one clear statement, indicating their rank and status: "Decisions: Fund — FP-17 (rank 1); Fund — P-04 (rank 2); Fund — P-12 (rank 3); Fund — P-09 (rank 4)."
